info.name: Management Agent API
managementAgent
Get Management Agent Count Summary

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the compartment to which a request will be scoped.

params.name: groupBy
params.description: The field by which to group Management Agents. Currently, only one groupBy dimension is supported at a time.

params.name: hasPlugins
params.description: When set to true then agents that have at least one plugin deployed will be returned. When set to false only agents that have no plugins deployed will be returned.

params.name: installType
params.description: A filter to return either agents or gateway types depending upon install type selected by user. By default both install type will be returned.

params.name: compartmentIdInSubtree
params.description: if set to true then it fetches resources for all compartments where user has access to else only on the compartment specified.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page at which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

items.docs:
Gets count of the inventory of agents for a given compartment id, group by, and isPluginDeployed parameters.
Supported groupBy parameters: availabilityStatus, platformType, version

params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending. If no value is specified timeCreated is default.

params.name: compartmentIdInSubtree
params.description: if set to true then it fetches resources for all compartments where user has access to else only on the compartment specified.

params.name: accessLevel
params.description: When the value is "ACCESSIBLE", insufficient permissions for a compartment will filter out resources in that compartment without rejecting the request.

params.name: dataSourceType
params.description: The type of the dataSource.

params.name: dataSourceName
params.description: Unique name of the dataSource.

Returns a list of Management Agents.
If no explicit page size limit is specified, it will default to 1000.
The response is limited to maximum 1000 records when compartmentIdInSubtree is true.

info.name: Lists the availability history records of Management Agent

params.name: managementAgentId
params.description: Unique Management Agent identifier

params.name: timeAvailabilityStatusEndedGreaterThan
params.description:
Filter to limit the availability history results to that of time after the input time including the boundary record.
Defaulted to current date minus one year.
The date and time to be given as described in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/rfc/rfc3339), section 5.6.

params.name: timeAvailabilityStatusStartedLessThan
params.description:
Filter to limit the availability history results to that of time before the input time including the boundary record
Defaulted to current date.
The date and time to be given as described in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/rfc/rfc3339), section 5.6.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page at which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Default order for timeAvailabilityStatusStarted is descending.

items.docs: Lists the availability history records of Management Agent
